operations.title: Intrinsic primes generate a formal determinant Euler product — corrected notation
operations.statement: In the completed multiplicative monoid algebra of the conditional initial semiring, each intrinsic prime p has rank-one identity-inertia determinant L_p=(1-[p])^(-1)=sum_(r>=0)[p^r]. Unique factorization gives the coefficientwise identity product_p L_p=sum_(a nonzero)[a]. The analytic character [a] maps to a^(-s) for Re(s)>1 and recovers the classical zeta Euler product, but the character, continuation, completion, and zero spectrum are not Carrier-derived.
operations.scope: Conditional pointed-pi_0 formal Euler theorem; no full-Carrier lift, physical authorization, analytic continuation, or spectral zeros.

authority_basis.summary: Repair a delimiter typo in the admitted formal Euler-product claim using the append-only supersession pattern.
